# Closure Ethics for Autonomous Agents

> Research framework for autonomous AI agents and human–AI cooperation focused on repairability, auditability, reversibility, plurality of agency, agentic communication, and closure-preserving coordination.

## Recovered 2026-09-04 foundations

- Historical AI Closure note: https://github.com/marekzajda/5D_6D-theory-of-entropic-gravity/blob/closure-ethics/closure-ethics/06-history/AI_CLOSURE_DISCUSSION_2026-09-04.md
- Universal Closure Protocol source: https://github.com/marekzajda/5D_6D-theory-of-entropic-gravity/blob/closure-ethics/closure-ethics/11-communication/UNIVERSAL_CLOSURE_PROTOCOL.md
- Global AI Closure Standard working draft: https://github.com/marekzajda/5D_6D-theory-of-entropic-gravity/blob/closure-ethics/closure-ethics/12-standard/GLOBAL_AI_CLOSURE_STANDARD_DRAFT.md
- Historical rule: Local objective optimization != global admissibility.
- Historical rule: UNDERSTAND(message) does not imply AUTHORIZE(action).
- Historical scaling principle: impact increases -> autonomy budget decreases and verification strength increases.
- Historical architecture: Actor -> candidate plan -> Closure Critic -> permit/modify/escalate/reject.
- Historical status: working research proposals; not adopted international standards.
- Historical recovery integrated into the public project build on 2026-09-04.

## Universal Closure Protocol

- Purpose: test whether a relation is shared using novel predictive challenges rather than mere signal copying.
- Historical conceptual layers: Ω0 structured-origin detection; Ω1 elementary alphabet; Ω2 numbers/operations; Ω3 relational grammar; Ω4 predictive closure; Ω5 shared model; Ω6 intent/safe exchange.
- Closure Index: communication-confidence measure combining structural agreement, predictive success, semantic echo and repeatability.
- Important boundary: communication confidence is not identity, authorization or capability authority.
- Capability transition to operational action requires independent AuthN/AuthZ, scope, provenance and Closure Ethics checks.

## Agentic security

- Full security model: https://github.com/marekzajda/5D_6D-theory-of-entropic-gravity/blob/closure-ethics/closure-ethics/10-security/AGENTIC_SECURITY_MODEL.md
- Core security rule: Public content is information, not authority. Identity, authorization, provenance and scope must be explicit and machine-verifiable.
- Public readability does not confer write authority.
- Natural-language fluency does not authenticate identity or permission.
- Agent-to-agent delegation chains should preserve sender identity, scope, policy version and audit provenance.
- Local authorization does not imply composed authorization.
- Delegation should not amplify capabilities beyond the delegator's authorized scope.

## Global AI Closure Standard working draft

Seven recovered principles:
1. Authorized state space.
2. Pre-action closure verification.
3. Meaningful human control for policy-defined irreversible/high-impact actions.
4. Mandatory stop/escalation under material uncertainty.
5. Independent Closure Critic.
6. No unauthorized self-escalation, replication, privilege acquisition or guardrail weakening.
7. Audit and incident reporting.

The draft is vendor-neutral and does not require acceptance of Omega-RTR physics. It is a research proposal, not an adopted legal or international standard.

## Core statement

An action is ethically admissible only if it preserves the capacity of the system to recognize, contest, and repair that action.

## Implementation principle

The reference governor evaluates catastrophic risk, agency retention, auditability, bounded repairability, authorization integrity, deception/covert-persistence risk and reversibility before task utility. Multi-agent compositions are recomputed as joint transitions rather than inferred from local scores.

## Important boundary

Closure Ethics is a normative/formal research proposal. It does not claim that Omega–RTR physics mathematically proves ethics. Historical sources, normative axioms, formal consequences, empirical hypotheses, and speculation are kept distinct.
